svg.text: One more FlowBox child (wraps to a second line): distinct models in order of first use. Tooltip gives counts and unattributed entries.
Same chip, single model. The “ran” side of a subagent row in the parent is this exact value (same query on the child session).
Run marker above the first assistant entry of each run (message, tool call, burst or subagent), inside that row, not a new list item.
Change marker names the new model and, dimmed, the previous one. Tool-only stretches below it need no label of their own.
Handoff caption: “requested by” = stored source_model; “ran” = models attributed in the linked child session.
Unknown says why: “child session not indexed”, “child model not recorded”, or “requested by: not recorded”.
A run that starts inside a collapsed burst shows “→ model” on the burst header, so collapsing never hides a change. NULL runs read “model not recorded”.
